items.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: And I got asked to join the Dorsey band that night by the leader, Buddy Morrow, who’s still on the band, over 20 years later now.

ctx.x: How did — your first big job, that you said man, I’ve been working towards this and this finally happened.

It’s kind of a two part thing. When I was living in Cleveland and I was playing of course in this polka band, and at the same time I started branching out and playing with jazz groups around town. Flash forward a few years, I’m in college. I get called to play at a jazz festival in Cleveland with my own group, and it’s me, the Teddy Wilson trio and the Tommy Dorsey band — a ghost band — but so anyway so I do this concert and it’s a big deal for me. And I got asked to join the Dorsey band that night by the leader,…
